sentences.text:

G.A. 
 Court No. - 30
 Hon'Ble Rajiv Gupta, J. 
Hon'Ble Tej Pratap Tiwari, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.
2.

The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following reliefs:-
"i. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the Opposite
Party nos.2 to 4 to conduct fair and proper investigation of F.I.R. No. 043 of 2023
dated 05.03.2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 504 and 506 I.P.C., P.S. Utraula,
District Balrampur.
ii.

It is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the Opposite Party nos. 2 to 4 to immediately take appropriate action against named accused persons i.e. Opposite Party nos. 5 to 10 in the F.I.R. No. 043 of 2023 dated 05.03.2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 504 and 506 I.P.C., P.S. Utraula,
District Balrampur.

(iii) Any other order or Direction which this Hon'ble court deems fit Just and proper,
may kindly be passed in favor of the petitioner in the interest of Justice".
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is the first informant in the present case and though the F.I.R. in the instant case has been registered on 05.03.2023, yet the police is not investigating the case in fair and impartial manner.

4. In view of the above, the petitioner may move an application before the respondent no.3- Superintendent of Police, Balrampur, highlighting her grievance and seeking fair and impartial investigation and if such an application is moved by the petitioner, respondent no.3- Superintendent of Police, Balrampur, shall ensure the fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in the present case.
5. With the aforesaid order, the present writ petition stands disposed of.
(Tej Pratap Tiwari,J.) (Rajiv Gupta,J.) November 6, 2025 Manoj  Nikhat Malik vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107156153/
